verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Will your grace run out
If I let you down
'Cause all I know
Is how to run

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
'Cause I am a sinner
If its not one thing its another

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Caught up in words
Tangled in lies

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
But You are a Saviour
And You take brokenness aside
And make it beautiful
Beautiful

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Will You call me child
When I tell you lies
'Cause all I know
Is how to cry

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
You make it beautiful
You make it beautiful
